stem.text: State what is meant by partition coefficient, Kpc.

guidance: CON if in terms of concentration of ‘solutes’.

points.text: (the) ratio of the concentrations of a solute / substance / compound between two (immiscible) solvents / two liquids (at) equilibrium

explanation.text: The partition coefficient describes how one solute shares itself between two immiscible solvents once equilibrium is reached: Kpc = [solute in solvent 1] / [solute in solvent 2]. The definition needs all four ideas: a ratio, of concentrations, of one solute, in two solvents at equilibrium. Writing 'solutes' (plural) contradicts the one-solute idea.

reasoningChain: Say it is a ratio of concentrations.
Say it is for one solute between two immiscible solvents.

inferredMistakes.text: Defining it as a ratio of amounts or masses rather than concentrations, or leaving out 'at equilibrium'.
Writing 'the concentrations of solutes', which the MS treats as a contradiction.

stem.text: Ethanedioic acid, H<sub>2</sub>C<sub>2</sub>O<sub>4</sub>, is more soluble in water than in the organic solvent ethoxyethane.
2.70 g of ethanedioic acid is shaken with a mixture of 50 cm<sup>3</sup> of ethoxyethane and 50 cm<sup>3</sup> of water at 298 K and left until there is no further change in concentrations.
The ethoxyethane layer requires 16.5 cm<sup>3</sup> of 0.200 mol dm<sup>–3</sup> NaOH(aq) for complete neutralisation.
Calculate the partition coefficient, Kpc, for ethanedioic acid between ethoxyethane and water.

guidance: Bullet 3 subsumes bullet 2 → [1]. Bullet 4 subsumes bullets 1,2,3 → [2].
A ecf for bullet 4 from calculated values of bullets 1 and 3, for example using the incorrect Mr / the wrong ratio.
NO ecf for M3 from bullets 1 and 2 for Kpc = [0.033 / 0.03].

points.text:
EITHER Solution 1 M1M2
• Initial moles of (COOH)2 = 2.7 / 90 or 0.03
• moles of NaOH = 0.0165 × 0.200 or 0.0033
• moles of (COOH)2 in ether = 0.0033 / 2 or 0.00165
• moles of (COOH)2 in water = 0.0300 – 0.00165 or 0.02835 ecf

or Solution 2 M1M2
• moles of NaOH = 0.0165 × 0.200 or 0.0033
• moles of (COOH)2 in ether = 0.0033 / 2 or 0.00165
• mass of (COOH)2 in ether = 0.00165 × 90 or 0.1485 g
• mass of (COOH)2 in water = 2.70 – 0.1485 or 2.5515 g ecf

explanation.text: The NaOH titration measures only the acid in the ethoxyethane layer. With a 1 : 2 ratio, moles of acid in ethoxyethane = ½ × 0.0165 × 0.200 = 0.00165 mol. The rest of the 2.70 g (2.70 / 90.0 = 0.0300 mol) is in the water: 0.0300 – 0.00165 = 0.02835 mol.

Kpc is a ratio of concentrations, but both layers have the same volume (50 cm3), so the volume cancels and the ratio of moles (or of masses) gives the same answer: Kpc = 0.00165 / 0.02835 = 0.058. The question asks for ethoxyethane to water, so ethoxyethane goes on top; the value is below 1, which fits the acid being more soluble in water. The reverse ratio (17.2) is also accepted for full marks.

reasoningChain: Moles NaOH = 0.0165 × 0.200 = 0.0033; acid in ethoxyethane = 0.0033 / 2 = 0.00165 mol.

inferredMistakes.text: Forgetting the 1 : 2 ratio and taking moles of acid in ethoxyethane as 0.0033.
Dividing the acid in ethoxyethane by the total acid (0.0300) instead of by the acid left in the water.

stem.text: The formula of ethanedioic acid is HOOCCOOH.
The formula of butanedioic acid is HOOCCH<sub>2</sub>CH<sub>2</sub>COOH.
Both acids are soluble in ethoxyethane and in water.
Suggest how the value of Kpc of butanedioic acid between ethoxyethane and water compares to the value of Kpc for ethanedioic acid between ethoxyethane and water.

guidance: I bullet 3 concentration of butanedioic acid is lower in water.

points.text: Kpc would be higher / larger (if Kpc < 1 in 4(b)) (for butanedioic acid) (ecf from 4(b)) ora
butanedioic acid is less polar / more non-polar ora
so less soluble in water / more soluble in ethoxyethane ora or dissolves less in water / dissolves more in ethoxyethane

explanation.text: Both acids have two polar –COOH groups that hydrogen-bond with water. Butanedioic acid also has a –CH2CH2– chain, which is non-polar, so the molecule as a whole is less polar than ethanedioic acid. It is therefore less soluble in water and more soluble in ethoxyethane than ethanedioic acid. With Kpc defined as [ethoxyethane] / [water], a larger share in ethoxyethane gives a larger Kpc (above the 0.058 of 4(b)).
The comparison must be explicit: 'butanedioic acid is non-polar' on its own is ignored, because it is still a polar molecule; it is only less polar than ethanedioic acid.

reasoningChain: Compare structures: butanedioic acid has an extra non-polar CH₂CH₂ chain.
So it is less polar than ethanedioic acid: less soluble in water, more soluble in ethoxyethane.
Kpc (ethoxyethane/water) is therefore larger for butanedioic acid.

inferredMistakes.text: Calling butanedioic acid 'non-polar' without comparing it with ethanedioic acid.
Arguing that a bigger molecule has more hydrogen bonding with water and so a smaller Kpc.

issues.note: MS 写 'Kpc = (0.1485 ÷ 100) ÷ (2.5515 ÷ 100)'，题中两层体积都是 50 cm3，除以 100 疑为 MS 错误（应为 50），但两边体积相同可约去，不影响结果 0.058；照抄。
'NO ecf for M3 from bullets 1 and 2 for Kpc = [0.033 / 0.03]' 中的 0.033 疑为 0.0033（NaOH 摩尔数）的笔误；照抄。
MS 的 'EITHER Solution 1 … or Solution 2' 两种解法各自 M1M2（四个 bullet）+ M3，转录为 points 1–4（1、3 为两种解法的 bullet 组，2、4 为各自 M3）。分值栏印成 '(3' 与 '3)'，即两种解法共 3 分。右侧 '● ✓● ✓' 勾号标记未转录。
